description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 music video prompt with attached video evidence from @ou_zhen599.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3音乐视频提示词。

prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second, 16:9, cinematic photoreal action-thriller image-to-video short set entirely inside the same rain-soaked cyberpunk rooftop sniper nest. Keep the space continuous and unified: wet roof edge, puddles, steel structure, neon reflections, and distant blurred city lights always remain part of the same rooftop zone. No city overview, no incompatible space, no scene change. The atmosphere is cold, wet, hostile, and realistic: heavy rain, damp air, blue-gray base light with small magenta and tungsten reflections, real rooftop wind, real rain physics. Preserve the same adult elite female sniper throughout: stable Western facial structure, sharp nose bridge, precise lips, wet loose hair stuck to forehead, cheeks, neck, and collarbone, realistic skin texture with pores, cold wet shine, slight redness, and rain tracks, plus the same dark burgundy-black fitted tactical leather suit, boots, and gloves. Her sensuality comes only from mastery, precision, breath control, and lethal focus, never posing. The camera follows the action directly: low ground glide, side track, slight orbit, over-shoulder push, near-subjective scope alignment, extreme close reaction, impact hard cut, and short withdrawal. She remains in continuous motion: fast entry, slide-kneel set, small rain adjustment, magnification turn, windage correction, stock pressure, support find, forward weight shift, breath suppression, trigger pressure, sudden impact, collapse, and ground strike. At 00:00.000-00:01.800, a low ground-hugging camera races across the wet rooftop past puddles, reflections, ammo box, tripod feet, and raindrops striking water. It catches her boot stepping hard into a puddle. She drags the sniper rifle fast toward the roof-edge firing point, the gun body sliding tight to her leg line. Her steps are light, stable, ruthless. Her face is in pure task state: brow slightly pressed, upper lids narrowed, eyes locked forward, pupils stable, lips parted only by a fraction, jawline tight, side neck steady, breathing short and exact. Wet hair lifts and slaps back onto her face. [Shot 2] At 00:01.800, a medium-close side-follow with a slight orbit. She drops smoothly into a low slide-kneel, one knee down and one leg out, locking the stock into the shoulder pocket. Her left hand drives under the fore-end, her right hand twists the magnification ring, then she shifts half a step sideways out of the direct rain line and compresses the muzzle into the roof-edge firing angle. Her eyes do not widen, they sharpen. Pupils contract slightly, upper lids lower more, nostrils draw inward with breath control, lips edge tighter, and the right masseter briefly tightens, then settles. [Shot 3] At 00:03.800, an ultra-close detail stays on her side face, lips, optic edge, and gloved fingers. Wet hair clings to cheek and neck, rainwater runs along the jawline and collarbone edge. She brings her lips close to the optic rim and gently blows fog and water from the lens edge while the gloved hand adjusts the windage knob with extreme precision and locks it with the thumb. The tone is practical, expensive, restrained. Eyes never leave the target direction. During the blow, her gaze dips only slightly. Afterward, the lips close naturally, the mouth corners tighten inward, the throat gives one tiny swallow, and the neck-shoulder line stays taut. No dialogue. [Shot 4] At 00:05.900, an over-shoulder medium-close push. She leans further in, sets the right elbow, supports the rifle with the left palm, nudges the knee, and engages waist and hips to settle into the best firing angle. She keeps making small living corrections, never freezing. Full sniper mode arrives: blinking nearly disappears, the brow center gathers only once as the rifle fully marries the shoulder, the lips compress into a thinner line, the jaw tightens gradually, and a clean load-bearing contour forms from below the ear into the side neck. Breathing becomes almost invisible. [Shot 5] At 00:07.800, near-subjective aiming. The reticle enters frame, but never cut to a full overview; show only a distant blurred illuminated window shape and a vague standing silhouette so rooftop unity remains intact. Her trigger finger slowly takes pressure. The muzzle makes tiny breathing corrections. Reactions stay microscopic: the right eye locks hard, the left eye remains naturally half-closed, one tiny refocus correction passes through the eyeball, nostrils draw inward, the center line of the lips tightens, and the cheek structure lifts slightly from total facial stability. One raindrop crosses the lens edge. [Shot 6] At 00:10.500, an extreme close reaction shot holds only her right eye, optic rim, and half the face. Suddenly a cold flash crosses the glass that does not belong to her line. Her finger stops at the threshold of the shot, and the rifle only shifts by half an inch on instinct. Neck and shoulders lock solid. The change is instantaneous: pupil contracts within half a beat, the upper eyelid rises by only a trace, the brow ridge lifts less than half a degree, the lips part by one narrow line, the right masseter hard-locks, and the throat freezes for one suspended instant. No scream. [Shot 7] At 00:11.700, the impact. A bullet punches directly through the scope, exploding glass, metal fragments, rainwater, and a short fine blood mist backward toward her face. The impact zone is the orbit-to-upper-cheek area, with optic and face hit in the same frame. Her head is knocked violently off line, then the neck support fails completely. The right eye loses focus instantly, the left eye cannot close in time, and the mouth is shaken slightly open without a cry. Blood remains realistic and contained: a short spray, thin mist, blood on the shattered lens, never a fountain. [Shot 8] At 00:12.400, collapse begins through total loss of control. The shoulder fails first, then the head tips uncontrollably, the core loses support, the stock slips from the shoulder pocket, both hands lose coherent control, and the rifle hits the roof and slides into standing water. Her chin no longer holds the aiming line. Her gaze goes vacant, lids half-open or dropping, facial muscles releasing rapidly from prior control. [Shot 9] At 00:13.600, the aftershock on the ground. She crashes backward and sideways, with the back of the head and shoulder-blade area landing first, then the face turning with inertia to one side. Rain immediately strikes the face and wound edge. After one small involuntary rebound, she becomes completely still. Fingers slacken after losing the rifle. The eyes remain unfocused, perhaps half-open, but no longer aim anywhere. The shattered optic rests in the puddle as blood washes into thin red traces under the rain and neon trembles across the broken glass for a cold ending.

overall_soundscape: No dialogue. Build the full 15 seconds from rain, boot splash, leather friction, rifle handling, magnification and windage clicks, controlled breathing, the tiny breath blown across the optic edge, trigger pressure, the instant optic-destruction impact, metal fragmentation, wet rupture, and the rifle striking and sliding into a puddle. Emphasize rain on steel, gear movement, shoulder set, optic handling, glove friction, turret clicks, breath suppression, and near-silent trigger pressure before the shot. At the cold-flash beat, make the world tighten for a microsecond; then the scope hit lands with layered glass burst, metal crack, wet rupture, and hard backward shock. Finish with uncontrolled body drop, rifle skid, rain on flesh and shattered glass, and rain dominating the ending as the blood trail spreads in the puddle.

non_diegetic_music: Use almost no score. If any music is present, keep it as an ultra-low electronic pressure bed under rain and city atmosphere. It must never overpower breathing, optics, or impact mechanics. After the scope detonation, let the score disappear almost completely so broken glass, rain, and bodily collapse carry the ending.
